name: Ubiquiti UniFi
description: Reads the UniFi Network application (UniFi OS consoles such as Dream Machine and Cloud Key Gen2+, or a classic self-hosted controller): gateway, switches and access points, which device hangs below which, and which switch or access point each client is connected to, with Wi-Fi signal, band and link rate. Read-only. Not yet tested on real hardware.
author: Netlens
supports: UniFi OS consoles (Dream Machine, Cloud Gateway, Cloud Key Gen2+) (not yet tested)
Classic self-hosted controller, port 8443 (not yet tested)

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Written from the public API and tested against a simulated controller only: please test it on real hardware and report back (see the README).
Adds a diagnostic report: a Run diagnostic button on the plugin's page (Netlens 0.2.67 or newer) shows an anonymised description of what the controller answers, to copy or download.
